warnings: The callout 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x2.3 mm.' has three leaders — to the top chord and to web members; the bottom chord carries its own callout 'อะเส rectangular tube Ø-150x75x2.8 mm. หลังอะเสระดับ +3.51'. So T1's bottom chord IS the row-B steel ring beam: steel_section holds the top-chord/web section and the bottom chord is kept in bottom_chord_steel_section. The printed Ø before the size is the drawing's own symbol; the text says rectangular tube, so designation RHS.

Diagonals are drawn only in bays 2-3 and 4-5; bays 1-2 and 3-4 have verticals only (read as drawn). The top chord runs past grids 1 and 5 by about 1.0 m on the elevation without a printed dimension — the S-04 roof plans print the same overhang as 1.00.

Panel chain (1.000 x3 | 0.900 x5 | 1.000 x3 | 0.833 x3) and the 1-5 markers under it are recorded in the grid master (dimension_chains, view TRUSS T1); the panel points became x dummies per section 4 rule 4.

bottom_chord_steel_section.printed_as: อะเส rectangular tube Ø-150x75x2.8 mm.

elements.note: โครงถักเหล็กยาว 13.00 ม. วางบนเสา 5 ต้นตามแนวกริด 1-5 (แนว B ตาม S-04) ลึก 0.832 ม.; คอร์ดล่าง = อะเส 150x75x2.8 หลังอะเส +3.51, คอร์ดบนและท่อนในเป็น 100x50x2.3; ค้ำทแยงเฉพาะช่วง 2-3 และ 4-5
